label.purpose: Indices, code, state, categories, and metadata.

shadows.name: active-cell-glow
shadows.purpose: Connects the active value to the current trace step.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Runs the main operation in the current workspace.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--dsa-primary-container); color: var(--on-accent); font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font-sans-stack); transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--dsa-active); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--dsa-primary-container) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--dsa-border); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--dsa-text); font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font-sans-stack); transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--dsa-card); border-color: var(--dsa-border-strong); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--dsa-primary-container) 45%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--dsa-muted-soft); font: 500 10px/1.4 var(--font-mono-stack); letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--dsa-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--dsa-card); color: var(--dsa-text); font: 400 13px/1.4 var(--font-sans-stack); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--dsa-primary-container) 35%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--dsa-border-strong); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; min-height: 36px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--dsa-card); color: var(--dsa-text-strong); font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font-sans-stack); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--dsa-panel); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--dsa-primary-container) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--dsa-primary-container); }

components.name: Data Cell
components.description: Displays a value in the current structure.
components.css: .ds-data-cell { display: grid; min-width: 64px; min-height: 64px; place-content: center; gap: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--dsa-border-strong); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--dsa-elevated); color: var(--dsa-text-strong); text-align: center; font: 600 15px/1.2 var(--font-mono-stack); } .ds-data-cell:hover { border-color: var(--dsa-primary-container); } .ds-data-cell small { color: var(--dsa-muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; }

narrative.overview: Algora feels like a well-organized workbench where every instrument has a clear purpose. The system is precise, restrained, and information-dense. It rejects generic developer dashboards, neon cyberpunk algorithm tools, disconnected tutorial pages, novelty controls, heavy glass effects, purple gradients, and motion that delays the task.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal surfaces separate work regions without heavy shadows.
One forest-green signal identifies the current action.
Monospaced labels and values make indices and state changes easy to scan.
Responsive structure keeps controls and active state reachable on narrow screens.
Motion communicates state changes and respects reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Forest Signal identifies the single most important action in the current view. It is never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Data Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Indices, values, step counters, code, weights, and complexity notation always use Geist Mono with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Move one surface token lighter to create hierarchy. Never add a heavy card shadow to solve a layout problem.

dos: Do keep the data state, active code line, and explanation synchronized.
Do pair every state color with text, shape, or position.
Do use tonal surfaces and one-pixel boundaries for hierarchy.
Do test every visualizer at 320px, 390px, 768px, and desktop widths.
Do preserve keyboard operation, visible focus, reduced motion, and 200 percent zoom.
donts: Don't build generic developer dashboards filled with unrelated cards and decorative metrics.
Don't use neon cyberpunk algorithm styling that sacrifices legibility for atmosphere.
Don't separate prose, code, and examples into disconnected learning pages.
Don't add novelty controls, heavy glass effects, purple gradients, or motion that delays the task.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glass panels, colored side stripes, nested cards, or pure black and white.
Don't use an em dash in product copy.
